about: Weekly decision rules for the cut. Evaluated in order; the first match wins. Change one variable at a time.

inputs.records_14d: Complete daily records in the last 14 days (a weigh-in plus the day's food marked on or off plan).
inputs.rate_pct_week: Weekly loss as % of bodyweight: (mean of previous 7 weigh-ins - mean of last 7) / previous mean * 100.
inputs.adherence_pct: Share of the last 14 logged days that were on plan.
inputs.waist_change_cm: Latest waist minus the waist 14 days earlier (negative = smaller).
inputs.strength_down: The top set fell in two comparable sessions in a row.
inputs.fatigue: Average energy 2 or lower out of 5 over the last 7 days, or you flagged fatigue.

rules.action: No change yet. The app needs 12 complete days in the last 14 before it suggests anything.
Check sleep, deficit and stress. If the deficit is already large, add 100-150 kcal. Consider a deload week (half the sets, same weights).
Add 100-200 kcal (mostly carbs on training days) or cut one cardio session.
No change while strength and energy hold. Early weeks include water loss. Re-check next week.
No change. Losses slow as you get leaner; 0.3-0.5% is normal later in the cut.
Weight is stuck but your waist is shrinking. Hold for another week.
Do not cut calories. Hit the plan on 6 of 7 days first.
Remove 100-150 kcal (take it from fat or the carb-up) or add about 1,500 steps a day. One change only.

kcal_floor.note: The app will not suggest a target below this. Going lower needs a clinician.

guardrails.diet_break: Every 8-12 weeks, 1-2 weeks at maintenance calories with protein unchanged.
never: Dehydration, water loading or sodium manipulation
Raw eggs, raw meat or unpasteurised milk
Dosing, escalation or sourcing advice for any medication, including investigational drugs such as retatrutide
Fasts longer than 24 hours while taking appetite-suppressing medication, unless a clinician has agreed

red_flags.symptom: Severe or persistent abdominal pain (may spread to the back)
red_flags.advice: Stop and get urgent medical help (NHS 111, or 999 if severe).

red_flags.symptom: Repeated vomiting or unable to keep fluids down
Fainting, chest pain or a racing or irregular heartbeat
Yellow skin or eyes, or pain under the right ribs after fatty meals
red_flags.advice: See a GP promptly (possible gallbladder problem).

red_flags.symptom: Dizziness on standing, very dark urine or not passing urine
No bowel movement for 4+ days with pain or bloating
red_flags.advice: Speak to a pharmacist or GP.
